name: Splatt3R Training Procedure with Loss Masking
definition: A training strategy for feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction from uncalibrated stereo pairs that uses a loss mask to restrict gradient updates to visible regions, preventing the model from hallucinating unseen geometry.
summary: Splatt3R Training Procedure with Loss Masking is a feed-forward training pipeline that predicts 3D Gaussian primitives from uncalibrated stereo pairs, distinguishing itself by using loss masking to prevent hallucinating geometry in occluded regions.
